name: Metropolitan Museum of Art
freeEvidence: Official Collection API documents this JSON endpoint, no registration/key and CC0 Open Access datasets for unrestricted commercial/non-commercial use without fee. Department metadata only; image rights remain per object. Count the museum API once across catalog aliases.

name: Openwhyd
freeEvidence: Official Data Export API explicitly gives anyone free access without authentication to publicly posted tracks/playlists and documents format=json plus limit. Public track metadata only; no audio download, authenticated User API or music redistribution. Space requests responsibly.

name: Ensembl
freeEvidence: Official Ensembl REST reference documents anonymous gene-annotation GET. EMBL-EBI terms provide freely available data resources/tools and add no use/redistribution restrictions beyond original data owners. Preserve resource attribution and applicable source-data rights; this is annotation metadata, not controlled human data.

name: BioThings
freeEvidence: BioThings official site identifies MyGene.info as its hosted gene-annotation service. Official terms explicitly authorize access/use of MyGene.info data subject to retaining notices; public annotation GET needs no credentials. This public capability exposes only gene symbol/name; underlying source restrictions and research-only medical disclaimer remain. Count one BioThings API, not each data type.

name: Europe PMC
freeEvidence: Official REST documentation exposes public JSON bibliographic search. EMBL-EBI terms make data resources/tools freely available and add no restrictions beyond original owners. Read bibliographic metadata only; article full text, abstracts and linked media retain publisher-specific licences and are not licensed wholesale by this recipe.

name: DataCite API
freeEvidence: Official REST guide separates unauthenticated Public API metadata retrieval from authenticated Member API writes. Official data-use policy dedicates DOI metadata to CC0 and explicitly makes it free for use via the APIs. Retain attribution/community norms; linked datasets and personal rights are separate. No DOI registration or member operations.

name: Wikipedia
freeEvidence: Wikimedia provides public read access through the documented Action API; this GET retrieves page metadata without login. Content reuse is permitted subject to the applicable CC BY-SA/GFDL terms, attribution and share-alike. No edit/account/write operation; comply with User-Agent and API rate guidelines. Count Wikipedia aliases once.

name: Wikidata
freeEvidence: Official Wikidata access documentation provides public read APIs. Structured main-namespace data is published under CC0, permitting reuse without commercial restriction. This is one bounded entity-label read; no SPARQL scans, editing, private data or additional count per entity.

name: STAPI
freeEvidence: Maintainer documentation explicitly says STAPI can be accessed freely without API keys and documents its public Star Trek REST interface. One bounded season metadata read; respect third-party Star Trek marks/content. Count STAPI aliases once, not each resource or API version.

name: Imgflip
freeEvidence: Official pricing table explicitly includes Get top memes in Free; get_memes is a documented anonymous GET with a keyless curl example. This recipe reads template metadata only, excluding authenticated caption writes, AI, GIF generation, premium database search and paid endpoints. Image/content rights remain with owners.

name: MeowFacts
freeEvidence: Maintainer repository documents the public keyless GET service and count parameter. Its bundled API/fact data are provided under MIT, permitting use/reuse with retained licence notices. No paid feature or account; one fact only. Software/data permission is not an uptime guarantee.

name: Spaceflight News
freeEvidence: Official provider privacy policy states its website and accompanying APIs are provided free at no cost; SNAPI provider page identifies this public news API. One article metadata record; linked publisher articles/images keep their own rights. No full-text redistribution, paid key or account.

name: Genshin Impact
freeEvidence: Maintainer project documents this fan-made public game-data API and licenses the repository under Open Software License 3.0, permitting reuse subject to its terms. This recipe reads character metadata only; game trademarks/media remain third-party rights. No account, assets download or game actions.

name: Drupal.org
freeEvidence: Official API documentation permits read-only public node queries without credentials. Drupal.org content is CC BY-SA 2.0; sample/project code retains GPL terms. This recipe reads one public module metadata record, preserving attribution/share-alike obligations, not user/email/private data or writes.

name: Zenodo
freeEvidence: Official developer documentation exposes public record retrieval; official policies license metadata under CC0 except email addresses and allow harvesting. One public metadata record, no uploads/downloaded research files or restricted records. Files retain depositor licences; the metadata waiver does not cover personal email addresses.

name: Figshare
freeEvidence: Official Figshare policy makes public metadata unrestricted under CC0; official NIH repository guidance states public content/API is freely accessible without login. Public article list GET only, one result. Respect dataset-specific licences and one request per second; exclude accounts/private resources/uploads.

name: Bitbucket
freeEvidence: Official Bitbucket Cloud REST reference permits anonymous reads of public repositories; public metadata is available without a paid account or token. This bounded GET exposes one public repository name only. No repository content redistribution, private projects, writes, build minutes or authenticated features.

name: Launch Library 2
freeEvidence: Official provider states the entire database is accessible free, up to 15 unauthenticated requests per hour. One bounded launch metadata GET on supported v2.3.0. This is a distinct published product from Spaceflight News, not extra counts for launches/config datasets. Respect the 15/hour anonymous quota; no paid key or account.
